Golett

Ground Ghost

Unova · Generation 5

Golett is a Ground/Ghost-type Automaton Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 92 kg. It evolves into Golurk. Its highest base stat is Attack (74), with a base stat total of 303.
